talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_cybor: Now there's a proper cyborg. Haven't seen one in a long while.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: A cyborg, walking about in the open. Who did the work on you? I'd like to see their joins.
Frostborn hands, mostly.
It shows. Clean work. Not many left who can do it.
What's a cyborg?
You are. More made than born. There's an older word, but nobody here would know it.
Stop staring at my joins.
Hard not to. Fine, fine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_kin: Hail's own, head to heel. Who fitted you? I'd know their hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: Head to heel in our people's work. Somebody back home thought a great deal of you.
My kin made sure of it.
Then they did right by you. Keep it oiled, the cold here is the wrong kind.
Some of it I earned.
The best of it always is.
It's only gear.
Only gear. Listen to you. Your grandmother would weep.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_frost: That's our work. All of it. Who sold it to you, or who did you take it off?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: That's Frostborn work on you, more of it than I've seen on anyone not of our blood. How did you come by it?
A Frostborn friend fitted me.
Then you've a better friend than most. They don't fit strangers.
Bought it, piece by piece.
And paid well over the odds, I'd bet. Still, you got the real thing.
That's my business.
It's ours, actually. But keep your secrets.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_warri: Frostborn steel on a ground-dweller. They taught us the stars, you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: All that Frostborn work, on one of you. My people learned the dark between worlds from theirs. Did you know that?
I didn't. Tell me more.
Not much to tell. They crossed it first. We just crossed it angrier.
I've heard it said.
Then you've heard right. Wear it well.
Keep away from me.
Everyone says that. Few mean it as much as you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_timid: Gods keep us. What are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: Is there any of you left that's flesh? I'm sorry, I don't mean to stare. I just... what happened to you?
I'm still me under it. Honest.
Right. Of course. Sorry. It's just a lot of metal, that's all.
Frostborn work. It's safe.
If you say so. I'll stand over here all the same.
Boo.
Don't! Don't do that!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_greed: What did all that cost you? An arm? Ha. Well, two.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: That much Frostborn work, on one body. You could buy a farm with what you're wearing. Ever think of selling a piece?
Maybe one day.
When that day comes, you come to me first. I'll be fair. Fairish.
Not for sale.
Everything's for sale. You just haven't heard the right price.
Don't look at me like that.
Like what? Like a fortune on legs? Sorry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made_devou: The gods made you whole once. Who made the rest?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_more_made_: The gods made each of us whole, they say. Somebody's made a good deal of you since. Does it trouble you?
The gods let it happen. That's enough for me.
A good answer. I'll pray for the parts of you that are still yours.
Sometimes.
That's honest. Come by the shrine if it ever weighs on you.
Leave the gods out of it.
They're never out of it. But I'll not press you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.more_made: Is there any of you left that's flesh?!
You're more Frostborn work than flesh! Where does a body even get all that?
Friends like that, I'd like to have.
...Right. I'll not ask where his arms went.
Fair. Only it's hard not to look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.rig_frost: A trooper's rig, on you? Where's the trooper?
That's a rig. Our people's war gear. It doesn't usually walk about on someone else.
I found it in a wreck and mended it.
Then whoever wore it isn't wanting it back. Treat it well.
I built it at a forge.
From our designs, I'd bet. Well. At least someone's using them.
Clearly. Mind it doesn't decide otherwise.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.rig_timid: Oh! Oh, it's a person in there.
I thought you were one of those metal things that fall out of the sky. You're not going to... do anything, are you?
Good. Lovely. Pass through, then. Mind the hens.
I'm not doing anything! I'm just standing here!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.rig: Is that a whole suit of Frostborn work?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.open: That's a whole suit of Frostborn work you're walking about in. Is it heavy? Is it warm? Can you hear me in there?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.a.said: Ha! Well, good. I'll not shout, then.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.b.said: Everything is, compared to what it looks.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.c: I'd rather not talk about it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_rig.c.said: Fair enough. It's a fine thing all the same.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.stump_smith: There's a smith here can fit you. That's me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump_smit: You're short a limb and nothing in its place. I can forge you iron, or a carpenter can do you wood. Wood's cheaper. Iron lasts.
Come by the forge with the iron and we'll talk. I don't overcharge the maimed.
You do. You'd manage better with something on that stump.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.stump_kind: Oh, you poor thing. Sit down a moment.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump_kind: You've lost a limb and nobody's even fitted you a peg. Can I fetch you anything? Some water, at least?
Here. And if you need a smith, ours is by the well. Tell him I sent you.
If you say so. Still, you're welcome here.
It's not pity. It's manners. Suit yourself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.stump: You're managing with one? You'd want a peg for that, at least.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.open: Lost one, did you? I'm sorry for it. You'd want something fitted there, wood if nothing else.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.a.sa: Try the forge, if there's one here. Or a carpenter for wood.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.b.sa: And you still get about. That's something.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_stump.c.sa: No. Sorry. I didn't mean to stare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_woode: Mine's oak and it creaks. Yours moves like it was born on you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: Look at that. Mine's oak and it creaks in the rain, and yours moves like it was born on you. Where do I get one?
From the Frostborn, if they'll have you.
If. They never have me. Still, it's good to know they exist.
It cost me dearly.
I'd believe it. I'd pay it too, if I had it.
You don't.
No. I don't. Thank you for reminding me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_smith: I couldn't forge that in a hundred years. May I look at the joint?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's a made limb. Frostborn. I've only seen drawings. Would you let me look at the joint? I won't touch.
Go on, have a look.
Look at that. No pins, no rivets. I'll be thinking about this for a month.
It's fine as it is.
Oh, I know it's fine. That's the trouble. Mine aren't.
Hands off.
I said I wouldn't touch. Fine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_kin: Good work on your arm. Whose hand is it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's good work, that limb. Ours, and well kept. Was it fitted back home or here?
Back home.
I thought so. You can always tell. The joins sit flatter.
Here, by one of ours.
Then there's someone near who still remembers how. Good.
Does it matter?
To me it does. Never mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_frost: That limb's Frostborn-made. Who fitted it for you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's one of our limbs on you. We don't hand those out. Who fitted it?
A Frostborn friend.
Then they trust you. That's worth more than the limb.
I bought it fair.
Fair. Hm. I'll take your word for it. This time.
Nobody you'd know.
I know everyone who can fit one of those. But all right.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb_greed: That arm's worth more than my house.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_made_limb_: That's Frostborn work, that limb. Worth more than my house and the field behind it. If you ever need coin...
I'll keep that in mind.
Do! I'm always here. Always.
It's attached to me.
Things come unattached. Not that I'd want that. For you.
No.
You didn't let me name a price.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.made_limb: Can you feel things with that? Does it get cold?
That arm, or is it a leg? It moves like a real one. Can you feel with it? Does it hurt when it's cold?
Near enough real. Imagine that. My uncle would give his other arm for it.
Mine ache too, and they're my own. You're doing all right.
Sorry. It's only, I've never seen one up close.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_patrol: Good. Nobody should walk about without one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_pa: You wear a scouter. Good. Too many out here walk about blind. Keep it on, and keep it charged.
Then you'll see them coming before they see you.
What does it read on you?
More than you'd think. Less than I'd like. Move along.
I am. That's the point of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_kin: Still wearing your glass, I see. Good.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_ki: You wear your scouter like one raised to it. Most born here leave theirs in a drawer.
As it should be. Our people don't go about blind.
I'm still getting used to it.
It takes a winter or two. Then you'll feel naked without it.
A tool that sees for you. Mind you don't forget whose it is.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_wears: Yours is a newer make than mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_we: Your scouter. A newer make than mine, if I'm not mistaken. Does it read farther?
I knew it. I'll be saving up again, then.
Good. Then I didn't waste my money.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter_suspici: What's that glass for? Seeing through walls? Through me?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter_su: That glass over your eye. What is it you're reading off me? I've a right to know.
And how strong am I? No, don't tell me. I don't trust it.
That's what someone would say if it was something I'd mind.
I would. That's why I asked.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.scouter: Is that glass for seeing far? Can I have a look through it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_scouter.op: That's Frostborn glass over your eye, isn't it? What does it show you? Could I have a look?
Oh! It's all numbers and colours. How do you read any of it?
Does it? Then don't point it at me. I'd rather not know.
No. No, I suppose not. Still. Lovely thing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_too: Oak, is it? Mine too. Rain gets in the joint.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_too: You've a stand-in limb too. Does it ache when the rain's coming? Mine always knows a day before I do.
Ha! Then we're a pair of weathervanes. Good to meet you.
Lucky. Or you've a better carpenter than I had.
Fair. Neither do I, most days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_smith: That peg'll split by winter. I could forge you iron, for a price.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_smi: That wooden limb of yours. It'll split by winter if you lean on it like that. Come to the forge and I'll do you iron.
Bring the iron and we'll talk. I'll go easy on the work.
Until it doesn't. The offer stands.
Suit yourself. Wood's honest, I'll give it that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_kind: Sit a while, if it pains you. I'll bring a stool.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_kin: That limb must tire you, walking all day. Sit a while if you like. I'll bring a stool.
There. Rest as long as you need.
Still. The stool's here if you want it.
Of course. I only thought I'd ask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended_spiteful: Lost it in a fight, did you? Lost the fight too, by the look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended_spi: Wood where a limb should be. Lost a fight, did you? Or just careless?
I lost a fight. The other one lost more.
Ha. I'll believe that when I see him.
Or what? You'll hop at me?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gear.mended: A wooden limb? Does it hurt much?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.ope: You've a stand-in limb there. I hope it doesn't trouble you too much. How did it happen?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.a: A long story. I'm well enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.a.s: Good. You get about better than most I've seen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.gear_mended.b.s: Then I hope the other one looks worse.
